not_evidence: A draft is not a run. No cell has executed, no verdict is adjudicated, and none of these records may be cited as a cap-112 result.
question: At cap 112, are presence, admitted and asserted measured as comparable quantities on the same world edges, the same build and the same window, so a conversion or cap reading rests on an edge-level measurement?
claim: Q1's six gates describe an object relation, not a cap: A_W must be a subset of P, recorded per seed. The cap-40 record returned `CONSTRUCT VALID`. This record asks the same question with the cap the project intends to ship.

control_cell.why: a fresh-process rerun whose fingerprints must match the reading cell

design.world: the Gate-13 compositional world (16 tags, 112 derivable edges)
design.pairing: one cell per seed, paired with the cap-112 comparator row for that seed

gates.C1_build: one build at the pinned sha256 and cap 112
gates.C3_presence: P is a set with a digest and per-edge membership
gates.C4_denominator: W, P and S_ever non-empty; a zero denominator is NOT MEASURABLE
gates.C5_object: A_W is a subset of P; failure is OBJECT MISMATCH
gates.C6_witnesses: at least one positive A_W edge and one P-minus-A_W edge per seed
gates.C7_seed_axis: at least two distinct fingerprints across the six seeds
gates.C8_determinism: the control rerun reproduces its fingerprints and ordered admission window
gates.C9_comparator_row: each cell reproduces the cap-112 comparator row for its seed: world edges, present edges, asserted world edges and asserted fingerprint. This replaces the cap-40 `audit row reproduced` clause, whose published row does not exist at 112.

verdict_rule: Q1's own gate set over C1-C9: `CONSTRUCT VALID`, `OBJECT MISMATCH`, `NOT MEASURABLE`, `VOID`
gates_control: `--check` builds a record with a cap-40 design and one with C1 deleted and requires both to be rejected, so the guard can fail.
seed_reuse: the six historical audit seeds, reused so the level comparison is paired; declared against docs/presence_assertion_audit_0.14.0.json
